'''Pressure pirates''' were [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on the world of [[Yorn Skot]]. They forced ships into the depths of Yorn Skot until they were crushed and then used their industrial strength equipment to salvage the wreckage. One band of pressure pirates, working with [[Waverton]] and [[Podlong Foahl]], attempted to capture the ''[[Aurorient Express]]'' in [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].
